name: 会话状态
desc: 切分组/切视图写入 sessionStorage，刷新后仍停在原分组与视图；非法分组回落「全部任务」、非法视图回落「全部」；清空会话状态后回到默认。本用例 4 次 reload，每次 reload 后用宿主数值 wait 让页面复活，就绪轮询放在 eval 里（reload 后 T 已重置，后续步骤不依赖 T）

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.pickGroup = (name) => { const g = T.q('.gitem').find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.gname')) === name); if (!g) throw new Error('找不到分组：' + name); g.querySelector('.gname').click(); return true; }; T.view = (t) => T.click(T.q('st-button-group st-button').find((b) => T.tx(b).indexOf(t) === 0)); T.session = () => sessionStorage.getItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'helpers ready';

await T.ready('.add-group-btn'); if (T.session()) throw new Error('初始不应有会话状态：' + T.session()); T.pickGroup('默认'); await T.wait(350); const s1 = JSON.parse(T.session() || 'null'); if (!s1 || s1.groupFilter !== 'default') throw new Error('切分组应写入会话状态：' + T.session()); T.view('已归档'); await T.wait(350); const s2 = JSON.parse(T.session()); if (s2.view !== 'archived' || s2.groupFilter !== 'default') throw new Error('切视图应写入会话状态：' + T.session()); return 'ok';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.gitem.active')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.gitem.active')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const all = (s) => Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(s)); const active = all('.gitem.active .gname').map((n) => n.textContent.trim()).join(','); if (active !== '默认') throw new Error('刷新后应仍选中「默认」，实际 ' + active); const arch = all('st-button-group st-button').find((b) => b.textContent.trim().indexOf('已归档') === 0); if (arch.getAttribute('variant') !== 'filled') throw new Error('刷新后视图应仍是「已归档」：' + arch.getAttribute('variant')); if (root.querySelector('.empty').textContent.indexOf('归档箱是空的') === -1) throw new Error('归档视图的空状态文案不正确'); return 'ok';
sessionStorage.setItem('todo-ui-state', JSON.stringify({ view: 'trash', groupFilter: 'not-exist-group' })); return 'wrote bad state';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.gitem.active')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.gitem.active')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const all = (s) => Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(s)); const trash = all('st-button-group st-button').find((b) => b.textContent.trim().indexOf('垃圾桶') === 0); if (trash.getAttribute('variant') !== 'filled') throw new Error('合法视图「垃圾桶」应被恢复：' + trash.getAttribute('variant')); const active = all('.gitem.active .gname').map((n) => n.textContent.trim()).join(','); if (active !== '全部任务') throw new Error('不存在的分组应回落为「全部任务」，实际 ' + active); if (root.querySelector('.empty').textContent.indexOf('垃圾桶是空的') === -1) throw new Error('垃圾桶空状态文案不正确'); return 'ok';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.gitem.active')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.gitem.active')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const all = (s) => Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(s)); const allBtn = all('st-button-group st-button').find((b) => b.textContent.trim().indexOf('全部') === 0); if (allBtn.getAttribute('variant') !== 'filled') throw new Error('清空会话状态后应回到「全部」视图'); const active = all('.gitem.active .gname').map((n) => n.textContent.trim()).join(','); if (active !== '全部任务') throw new Error('清空会话状态后应回到「全部任务」，实际 ' + active); return 'ok';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
